name: Our Enemies
overview: Scripture reveals that though believers face opposition and persecution from their enemies, God faithfully protects and sustains them, as the Lord is our shepherd who provides and the Almighty under whose shadow we abide. Even in the midst of trouble, God stretches out His hand against the wrath of enemies to save and revive His people. Believers are called to respond with grace, offering kindness even to their adversaries, reflecting Christ’s teaching to bless those who revile us. Ultimately, the Lord promises victory by making enemies a footstool under His Son, affirming Christ’s sovereign authority over all opposition.
